## Task
Do A and B name the same business concept (the same real-world thing, so the classes model one concept under different names)? Concepts that merely share attributes such as an id or a date are not the same.

### A
concept: Membership Number
where: MemberRepository (uses), src/persistence/memberRepository.ts, component persistence

response.rationale: A and B are closely related but not the same concept. A, "Membership Number", is an identifier: MemberRepository (node 1cdbf101edd01700, src/persistence/memberRepository.ts) uses it as the lookup key in `return this.members.get(membershipNumber);`. B, "Membership", is the membership itself, the thing that key points to. RinkService (node 21c65604dec116b1, src/business/rinkService.ts) checks that a membership exists with `if (typeof memberNo !== "string" || !this.members.get(memberNo)) {` and otherwise throws "unknown membership number". The number is one attribute of a membership, not the membership itself, so these are two different concepts: an identifier versus the entity it names. That said, both snippets do the same lookup by member number. If the labels were only loosely chosen, they could point to the same thing, which is why confidence is moderate.
